_comment: VERSIONED EVID-02 CRITICAL-LOAD MEASUREMENT EVIDENCE SCHEMA. Documents the record shape a real, station-specific Nuolja (or Maitri/Bharati) critical-load measurement submission must satisfy before it could ever replace the SYNTHETIC_ENGINEERING_SCENARIO figures in CRITICAL_LOAD_HIGH_POWER_AUDIT.md / CRITICAL_LOAD_ONLINE_SOURCE_AUDIT.md. No record conforming to this schema exists anywhere in this repository as of this pass -- this file is an acquisition template, not evidence.

circuit_or_equipment_identity.equipment_description: string -- what this circuit actually powers (e.g. 'life-support heating loop', 'comms rack', 'kitchen/galley')
circuit_or_equipment_identity.criticality_rationale: string -- WHY this circuit is classified critical (survival-relevant vs. comfort-relevant), citing the station's own operational safety doctrine if one exists; must not merely restate the project's own 9.865 kW vs 11.6 kW framing without a station-specific justification

measurement_method.method: one of: continuous_metering | periodic_manual_read | estimated_from_nameplate | other (if other, must be described)

instrument_identity.meter_or_instrument_id: string -- serial number or station asset tag
instrument_identity.calibration_authority: string -- who/what certified the calibration, or 'UNKNOWN'

timestamp_and_station_identity.each_sample_timestamp_utc: ISO-8601 UTC, explicit offset, one per sample row (this schema expects a time series, not a single scalar)

missing_reading_and_operating_mode_treat.missing_reading_policy: Every sample gap must be recorded explicitly as null/missing with a reason code (e.g. SENSOR_OFFLINE, METER_UNREACHABLE, SCHEDULED_MAINTENANCE) -- never interpolated, zero-filled, or mean-filled and then presented as measured.
missing_reading_and_operating_mode_treat.operating_mode_at_each_sample: one of: NORMAL | REDUCED_LOAD_SHED | EMERGENCY | MAINTENANCE | UNKNOWN -- required per sample, since a critical-load figure measured during REDUCED_LOAD_SHED is not the same quantity as one measured during NORMAL operation.

source_files_and_provenance.raw_source_file_or_log_reference: string -- exact file/log/SCADA-export this record was extracted from, independently re-checkable
source_files_and_provenance.extraction_method: string -- how the record was derived from the raw source (manual transcription, automated export, etc.)
source_files_and_provenance.submitted_by: string -- name/role of the person submitting this record

validation_and_acceptance_checks: Every sample has a station_identity matching a real, named station (not a placeholder).
Every sample's operating_mode is recorded, not defaulted to NORMAL.
Every missing reading carries an explicit reason code, not a silently-interpolated value.
measurement_period_start_utc < measurement_period_end_utc, and sample timestamps fall within that range.
criticality_rationale is station-specific, not a restatement of the project's own synthetic-scenario framing.

At least one of {continuous metering spanning >=7 days, or a documented circuit-by-circuit nameplate audit cross-checked against at least one metered peak-load event} before this record is treated as sufficient to inform CL-01's real-data reconsideration -- a single instantaneous reading is explicitly INSUFFICIENT.

explicit_non_substitution_clause: A record conforming to this schema must NEVER be inferred from, backed into, or reconciled with CRITICAL_LOAD_HIGH_POWER_SCENARIO.md's provisional 11.6 kW synthetic figure. That figure's SYNTHETIC_ENGINEERING_SCENARIO / provisional status (CL-01, decided 2026-10-17) is preserved explicitly and is not altered, superseded, or informed by anything in this schema or any submission made against it, unless and until a real measurement is obtained and independently validated.
